purpose: Development runtime probes frozen before this probe batch; no held-out or repair-benefit claim
authoring_context: Screening symptoms and buggy source were visible; reference regression fixtures were used for screening. Full target source fixes were not inspected while authoring these probes.

common_contract.preconditions: Pinned source is imported from a new workspace; Python and dependency environment recorded
common_contract.controls: Code/environment held constant; only the specified schedule, close operation, or update input changes
common_contract.reset: New snapshot copy and subprocess per candidate; each within-probe comparison constructs fresh objects
common_contract.extractor: JSON observations and actual source-import check; qualitative mechanism interpretation is manual
common_contract.unresolved: True mechanism can be absent or multiple causes can interact; no probability claim

hypotheses.clock_direction: Backward clock samples affect the next scheduled callback
hypotheses.overrun: Callback overruns cause the repeated scheduling value
hypotheses.period_units: Callback period units are wrong independently of clock direction

probes.prediction: A direction-specific defect need not appear; a general period defect can appear

probes.variable: Negative clock deltas with fixed period
probes.prediction: A direction-specific defect changes schedule advancement; pure overrun should not need negative deltas

probes.variable: Tiny negative versus zero versus positive delta
probes.prediction: A direction boundary defect can occur even without a long callback

probes.variable: Positive durations exceeding the callback period
probes.prediction: An overrun defect appears; a backward-only defect need not appear

hypotheses.delayed_gc: Object collection is delayed without a persistent registration defect

probes.prediction: An open native loop differs from a closed loop retained in the registry
Persistent registration can grow with cycle count despite closed native loops

probes.variable: Explicit garbage collection after ten closes
probes.prediction: A pure collection delay can disappear; strong retained registration can remain

probes.variable: Close through the native asyncio API
probes.prediction: Native and wrapper close paths can differ; check closure and registration separately

hypotheses.ownership: An update from a different worker overwrites running status
hypotheses.identity: Task identity routing changes the wrong task
hypotheses.order: Status depends on update order independently of ownership

probes.prediction: An ownership-dependent rule differs by actor at the same claimed task

probes.variable: Update the running task versus another task
probes.prediction: A routing defect can affect A when B was updated

probes.variable: UNKNOWN versus PENDING versus DONE report from another worker
probes.prediction: A status-specific guard differs across reports rather than all updates

probes.variable: Report before versus after work is claimed
probes.prediction: A claim-state boundary defect differs by update position
